													end

      
													4'd10: begin : sv2v_autoblock_693

      
														reg signed [31:0] i;

															if (mask[i] && write_data[i])

      
																data[i] = 1'sb1;

      
													end

      
													4'd11:

      
														if (mask != 1'b0)

      
															data = 1'sb1;

      
													4'd12: begin : sv2v_autoblock_694

      
														reg signed [31:0] i;

      
														for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
															if (mask[i] && !write_data[i])

      
																data[i] = ~current_value[i];

      
													end

      
													4'd13: begin : sv2v_autoblock_695

      
														reg signed [31:0] i;

      
														for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
															if (mask[i] && write_data[i])

      
																data[i] = ~current_value[i];

      
													end

      
													default:

      
														;

      
												endcase

      
												get_sw_write_next_value = data;

      
											end

      
										endfunction

      
										function automatic [0:0] get_hw_next_value;

      
											input reg [0:0] current_value;

      
											input reg write_enable;

      
											input reg [0:0] write_data;

      
											input reg [0:0] set;

      
											input reg [0:0] clear;

      
											reg [0:0] set_clear [0:1];

      
											reg [0:0] value;

      
											begin

      
												if (!HW_ACCESS[1])

      
													set_clear[0] = 1'sb0;

      
												else

      
													set_clear[0][0:0] = set;

      
												if (!HW_ACCESS[2])

      
													set_clear[1] = 1'sb0;

      
												else

      
													set_clear[1][0:0] = clear;

      
												begin : sv2v_autoblock_696

      
													reg signed [31:0] i;

      
													for (i = 0; i < WIDTH; i = i + 1)

      
														if (set_clear[0][i])

      
															value[i] = 1'sb1;

      
														else if (set_clear[1][i])

      
															value[i] = 1'sb0;

      
														else if (HW_ACCESS[0] && (write_enable == HW_WRITE_ENABLE_POLARITY))

      
															value[i] = write_data[i];

      
														else

      
															value[i] = current_value[i];

      
												end

      
												get_hw_next_value = value;

      
											end

      
										endfunction

      
										reg [1:0] sw_update;

											if (EXTERNAL_MASK)

      
												rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.read_data = read_data & i_mask;

      
											else

      
												rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.read_data = read_data;

      
										end

      
										always @(*) begin

      
											if (_sv2v_0)

      
												;

      
											o_write_trigger = trigger[0];

      
											o_read_trigger = trigger[1];

      
											o_value_unmasked = value;

      
											if (EXTERNAL_MASK)

      
												o_value = value & i_mask;

      
											else

      
												o_value = value;

      
										end

      
										always @(*) begin

      
											if (_sv2v_0)

      
												;

      
											if (SW_READ_UPDATE)

      
												sw_update[0] = rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.read_valid;

      
											else

      
												sw_update[0] = 1'sb0;

      
											if (SW_WRITABLE)

      
												sw_update[1] = get_sw_write_update(rggen.u_block_1.g_register_file_2.g[_gv_i_6].g_register_file_0.g_register_1.g_bit_field_0.g[_gv_j_6].bit_field_sub_if.write_valid, i_sw_write_enable, sw_write_done);

      
											else

      
												sw_update[1] = 1'sb0;

      
											hw_update = 1'sb0;

      
										end

      
										if (1) begin : g_sw_write_done

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_2B793;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_2B793 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) sw_write_done = sv2v_tmp_2B793;

      
										end

      
										if (1) begin : g_write_trigger

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_45ED3;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_45ED3 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) trigger[0] = sv2v_tmp_45ED3;

      
										end

      
										if (1) begin : g_read_trigger

      
											wire [1:1] sv2v_tmp_7C982;

      
											assign sv2v_tmp_7C982 = 1'sb0;

      
											always @(*) trigger[1] = sv2v_tmp_7C982;

      
										end

      
										if (!STORAGE) begin : g_value

      
											always @(*) begin

      
												if (_sv2v_0)

      
													;

      
												value = i_value;

      
											end

      
										end

      
										else begin : g_value

												else if (sw_update[0])

									end

      
									assign u_bit_field.i_clk = i_clk;

									assign o_register_file_2_register_file_0_register_1_bit_field_0[(i * 2) + j] = u_bit_field.o_value;
